assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
There is concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia contributing to symptoms and potential stroke risk
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned for mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code Z86.73 is assigned for personal history of transient ischemic attack
The CPT code 93271 is used for the cardiac event monitor
The service is medically necessary to evaluate recurrence of palpitations and lightheadedness against the patient's established cardiac history
